title: Chapter 319 The Long River Of Spear
content:
Chapter 319 The Long River Of Spear

At this time, the others were still hesitating.

Lu Xue lowered her head and pondered at this moment.

She felt more and more that there was a force in her body that was about to gush.

At this time, the ancient ring on Lu Xue's finger suddenly trembled slightly.

Feeling the unusual movement of the ancient ring, Lu Xue thought she was dazzled.

But the movement of the ancient martial arts is getting bigger and bigger.

In the distance, the huge bronze statue also began to tremble.

Seeing this scene, everyone present looked alert.

"The statue is weird."

One person said in a voice.

However, Lu Xue felt that there seemed to be some connection between the ancient ring and the statue.

Just when Lu Xue wanted to come forward to find out.

A huge roar suddenly sounded from the side.

Everyone was shocked.

The next moment, a figure flew out from one of the door holes.

boom!

The figure hit the ground directly.

Seeing the embarrassed figure hit on the ground, everyone present exclaimed in surprise.

"Tang Hao!"

Everyone did not expect that there was an existence in this bronze palace that could make Tang Hao like this.

You know, if Tang Hao's strength is among them, he is definitely the top-level existence.

Could it be that the big boss in the bronze palace came out?

At this time, Tang Hao's face was very pale, but more of it was still ugly.

He didn't expect that it was all from their Tiandi Academy. Now he was embarrassed.

And at this time, footsteps came from afar.

Everyone looked at the door hole in the distance with a vigilant look.

The next moment, a familiar figure appeared in front of everyone.

Chen Mingyu!

"How is that possible!"

Xiao Luo exclaimed in surprise and beat Tang Hao into this, it turned out to be Chen Mingyu.

Isn’t Tang Hao one year higher than Chen Mingyu? Why is this happening?

This is not only a place where Xiao Luo is confused, but also a place where everyone present is confused.

At this time, Tang Hao gave the answer.

"He ate the Emperor's Salpid Fruit and broke through to the fourth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm!"

The fourth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm!

Everyone looked solemn.

Chen Mingyu himself has strong combat power and is a top genius who fights beyond the level.

Now, Chen Mingyu's realm has reached the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor realm. No wonder even Tang Hao was beaten like this.

However, what they were curious about was that if the Emperor Swallow Fruit wanted to mature, it needed blood to pay tribute. Where did they find so much blood in this bronze palace?

"Oh? I didn't expect that there are quite a few people in your Tiandi Academy. Why do you want to beat me up in groups?"

Chen Mingyu looked at everyone present, with no fear in his eyes, but instead had a playful smile.

Everyone was slightly stunned when they heard Chen Mingyu's words.

The next moment, all the people present from the Tiandi Academy attacked Chen Mingyu.

For a moment, the terrifying power filled the entire palace.

Chen Mingyu, who was concentrated in fire, looked unbelievable.

Is this a fucking member of Tiandi Academy?

What about the gentleman of academy who promised to be a promise?

It's really a group fight!

If everyone was hesitant before, then Chen Mingyu, who has now been promoted to the fourth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm and seriously injured Tang Hao, made everyone completely make up their minds.

If they don’t join forces, they may be solved by Chen Mingyu one by one.

However, Chen Mingyu was caught off guard at the beginning and was at a disadvantage.

But when Chen Mingyu came to his senses, Chen Mingyu completely showed the horror of the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Boom boom boom boom!

The sharp silver spear broke through all the attacks of everyone.

For a moment, everyone was beaten to retreat step by step.

It is hard to imagine that the powerful men on the list of monsters were unable to fight back when facing Chen Mingyu.

"Hmph, just by you, even if you go together, you will not be my opponent!"

"It's just right, execute you all!"

"The long river of guns!"

Buzz —

I saw a huge river suddenly condensed in front of Chen Mingyu.

It is a long river condensed by the great way of guns, and it contains the supreme power of guns.

Seeing this gun, everyone was shocked.

This is the difference between the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm and the early stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

In the middle stage, you can project the ultimate of your own cultivation, the long river of the great way!

With the power of the Dao Long River, we will implement a dimensional reduction attack on opponents in the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Of course, there will be some terrifying geniuses who rely on their hard power to force the river of the great way.

But at this moment, it was obvious that everyone was unable to break the power of Chen Mingyu's gun.

boom!

Suddenly, a terrifying gun light surged out from the gun Taoist chief Hanoi and attacked everyone in the distance.

Seeing this scene, everyone hurriedly used their strongest power to resist.

If you run away at this moment, you will really be dead without a burial place.

If you fight with all your strength, there is still hope.

However, it is obviously unrealistic to defeat Chen Mingyu across the level.

As another dazzling gun flashed, everyone immediately vomited blood and flew backwards.

"Hahahaha, now starting from the beginning, the entire Bronze Palace will be the thing in my pocket of Chen Mingyu!"

Chen Mingyu's smile gradually became ferocious.

The people in the distance looked even more gloomy.

In the dim room, the phantom looked at Chen Mingyu at this moment and nodded slightly, "Sacrificing his teammates, seeking strength, and doing whatever it takes for his strength."

On the side, Lu Daosheng said calmly: "Do you agree with this method?"

The phantom smiled and said, "I don't agree, but I don't object. Everyone has their own way. Sometimes, the process does not necessarily matter, as long as the result is right."

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly.

“I think the process is more important than the result.”

If he cared about the result, he would not let his daughter take the risk of saving the fairy world by himself.

Compared to the result, he wanted Lu Xue to grow in this process more.

Even if he is gone in the future, Lu Xue can still live a good life on her own.

When he heard Lu Daosheng's words, the phantom said nothing.

Everyone has different ideas, and he doesn't need to dispute anything.

Inside the hall.

Everyone in the Tiandi Academy was in trouble at this moment.

Facing Chen Mingyu, even if everyone joins hands, they are not the opponent.

Could it be that I can only escape?

Although everyone present, except Chu Lingsheng, all scoffed at running away.

But when facing life and death, you will still choose to follow your heart.

However, escaping is also in a situation where there is no way to go.

At this time, a figure suddenly appeared in front of Lu Xue.

"Huh? Chu Lingsheng, what are you doing?"

Lu Xue looked at Chu Lingsheng in front of her and said in confusion.

Chu Lingsheng handed Lu Xue a ring, which was the one that Lu Xue gave him at that time.

"Give it, this ring contains half of all my gains in the ancient battlefield. I fulfilled the agreement and we don't owe each other."

Looking at the ring in his hand, Lu Xue was slightly stunned, "You, you,"

"I'm going to run away, goodbye."

After leaving this sentence, Chu Lingsheng turned around and left, and the ghostly figure disappeared into the hall in the blink of an eye.

Seeing Chu Lingsheng leave, Lu Xue looked ugly, and the rest of the people were the same.

"This Chu Lingsheng, I will definitely write to the dean for his book."

Tang Hao recovered a little at this time, stood up and gritted his teeth.
